name: decision-router
description: Picks the right Claude model for every message, so your plan lasts longer. Easy questions go to a faster model, hard problems to a stronger one, and you never have to switch models yourself.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Watch only shows which model the router would pick, without changing anything. Switch models lets it change the model for you. You can also change this at any time with /router.

preference.title: What matters more
preference.description: Save usage leans toward faster, lighter models so your plan lasts longer. Best answers leans toward stronger models.

allow_fable.title: Use Fable for the hardest tasks
allow_fable.description: Lets the router choose Fable for very hard tasks. Fable may use your usage credits instead of your plan.

backend.title: Decision model
backend.description: A small model that reads each message and rates how hard it is. Use a hosted service, or run one on your own computer so your messages stay with you.

local_url.title: Server address
local_url.description: For llama.cpp, Unsloth or SGLang. Leave empty when the server runs on this computer on its usual port. Example: http://10.0.0.9:9931

local_api_key.title: Server key
local_api_key.description: For llama.cpp, Unsloth or SGLang, only if your server asks for a key. To remove a saved key, enter none.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflare_account_id.description: For Cloudflare. You'll find it on the Workers AI page of your Cloudflare dashboard.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflare_api_token.description: For Cloudflare. Create a token that can only use Workers AI. To remove a saved token, enter none.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: For TypeSafe. To remove a saved key, enter none.

decision_model.title: Model name (advanced)
decision_model.description: Leave empty to use the usual model for your decision model. Set it only when your server runs several models.

min_confidence.title: Confidence needed to switch (advanced)
min_confidence.description: How sure the decision model must be before the router changes models. Higher means fewer switches. The default is 0.45.

timeout_ms.title: Wait time in milliseconds (advanced)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the decision model before keeping your current model. 0 uses the default: 2.5 seconds for hosted services and 8 seconds for your own server.
